text:
Type: solid wood dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: solid birch with a clear lacquer, visible wood grain
Colors: light natural birch, pale blond wood
Shape: wide flat panel backrest between straight posts, thick solid seat with a deep apron, square legs with low side stretchers, sturdy boxy frame, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, calm, honest, sturdy
Goes with: light wood tables, white walls, linen and black accents; Scandinavian or Japandi dining rooms and kitchens

product.name: NORRKER
product.description: Durable and hard-wearing; meets the requirements on furniture for public use.
